open_issues.text: api_subscribe takes only a filter, so the shell cannot resume from a cursor. After a stream close ({closed:true}) TauriTransport resubscribes with backoff 0.5-8 s, resets lastSeq and calls onSnapshotRequired('cursor_expired'); {dropped:N} maps to onSnapshotRequired('overflow'). This is weaker than HttpTransport's cursor resume. It follows the P6.2 Rust API, not the design wording 'same replay semantics'.
